meta.title: Shuguang Intelligence
meta.description: An explicit DSH window for an independent local Dawn service. Does not reuse DSH models, sessions or credentials.

title: Shuguang Intelligence
intro: Connect to an independently running Dawn service. Only commands submitted here are forwarded; DSH conversation history is never read.
boundary: For Docker, select docker and configure the Host repository absolute path and existing Docker context/project. For HTTP, configure endpoint and either tokenFile or tokenEnv (not the secret value). Docker only execs the running dawn container, without exporting tokens or publishing ports. Opening this panel does not initialize, start, wake or probe the companion.
directoryNotice: Refresh sends an authenticated GET /models to Dawn's configured provider, without generation or conversation history.
revisionNotice: Read status first, then use its actual revision. Conflicts are not retried. Awake is persistent state, not a process heartbeat.
thinkingNotice: Selection is process-local to Dawn; it does not change DSH's model or reset budgets. Off omits reasoning_effort; it does not guarantee disabled reasoning.
cost: Sending discloses this message to Dawn's configured model provider and spends shared calls. Failure or cancellation may already be charged; never resend automatically.
failure: Success was not confirmed: configuration is missing, the service refused, the connection failed, or the request was cancelled. Read status again instead of blindly resending; cancellation does not prove the server did not commit.
learning: Learning remains an explicitly authorized foreground learning-run with a local pack and budget. This panel does not start learning, migrate data or recover pending calls. Leaving cancels this client's request, not the independent service.
